title: Manifest enrichment and publishable profile generator for new models
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated pipeline that enriches newly ingested model manifests with deterministic pin metadata, runtime compatibility tags, and a publishable performance profile (human-readable + machine consumable). The generator should produce: 1) a signed manifest JSON with provenance fields (source url, ingestion hash, uploader, ingestion date); 2) a deterministic pin hash algorithm output and pinning recommendation; 3) a performance profile artifact that includes latency/throughput matrices across target sequence lengths and quantization modes, test harness inputs, and quality regression notes; 4) a docs-ready markdown summary for the model catalog and a versioned catalog index entry. The pipeline must include validation/linting steps, canary publish behavior for new pins, and a rollback path. Aim for backward compatibility with existing catalog consumers and minimal runtime changes to the serving runtime.
acceptance_criteria: New model manifests are produced by the enrichment generator and pass the catalog linter without manual edits
Deterministic pin hash generated for every new manifest; hash algorithm documented in the PRD
Performance profile for each model is stored in /catalog/perf-profiles and renders correctly in the console docs page
Canary publish flow allows 1% traffic to pinned variant and automatic rollback on regression alerts
Automated tests covering manifest schema, pin stability across re-ingests, and perf profile sanity checks included in CI

implementation_plan: Week 1: Finalize manifest schema and deterministic hashing algorithm, implement linter rules
Week 2: Build enrichment pipeline to attach perf-profile and provenance metadata; wire up perf-harness to output canonical speed matrices
Week 3: Add canary publish automation, implement rollback hooks, and integrate with console indexer
Week 4: Complete docs PR, add CI tests, run a controlled on-boarding of 3 community models as pilot
Post-launch: Monitor canary metrics for 2 weeks, iterate on perf profile granularity and rollout thresholds
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Pin hash changes for equivalent manifests due to non-deterministic fields. Mitigation: Strict canonicalization and explicit ignored-keys list in generator.
Risk: Perf profiles generate noisy signals causing false rollbacks. Mitigation: Use aggregated windows and require multi-metric regression (latency + quality) before automated rollback.
Risk: Backwards compatibility break for older console consumers. Mitigation: Publish schema version field and provide compatibility adapter in catalog indexer.
